title: 第3827章 杀人猿入仙门第3826章 古仙路上的可怕生物
lines: 诛仙剑狠狠地劈在了人猿的掌爪之上，如同劈在了一块仙金之上，爆发出了金铁之声，一股实质化的狂暴力量，顿时肆虐而开，令得本就濒临崩溃的古仙路，顿时摇摇欲坠，巨震不止。
余波肆虐间，许辰整个人向后倒飞了出去，紧握诛仙剑的右手，微微发麻，看着那仅退了一步的人猿，心头不由得一沉，这人猿虽然实力不复巅峰，但力量依旧强得可怕，而且肉身无比坚硬……
许辰倒飞之时，稳住身形的人猿，根本不给许辰丝毫喘息的时间，它身化残影，一双掌爪疯狂挥舞，黑色爪痕呼啸而出，如同锋利无比的剑气一般，撕开虚空，朝着许辰笼罩了过来。
面对着人猿这般凶残的攻势，许辰一脚猛地践踏而下，强行稳住了身形，而后挥舞诛仙剑，抵挡那扑面而来的道道爪痕。
“叮叮叮叮叮！
剑光与爪痕激烈碰撞，金铁之声响彻不绝。
许辰一时之间竟然显得有些狼狈，被人猿的攻势稳稳压制一头。
许辰虽然处于下风，但他的眼神确实无比的冷静，而他的攻势也是没有丝毫的慌乱。
“叮叮叮叮叮！
金铁之声络绎不绝。
许辰被人猿杀的不断后退。
铛的一声。
许辰身体一震，再次倒飞了出去。
然而。
就在许辰倒飞的那一瞬。
他的眼底掠过了一抹凌厉
“殛雷掌！”
蓄势已久的攻势终于完成了，低吼一声，一掌猛地拍出。
无尽仙力呼啸而出，裹挟着亿万雷霆之力，化为一只雷霆大手，狠狠对着人猿镇杀了过去。
殛雷掌，中品仙术！
许辰不仅将这门仙术修炼有成，还将之修炼到了巅峰层次。
这一掌又是许辰蓄势已久的一掌，威力之强，远超想象，足以轻易地秒杀任何一名地仙境的高手。
这道无比凶残的攻势，直接是将人猿狠狠地拍飞了出去，如同一颗流星一般，砸在仙路之上。
许辰缓缓呼出一口气。
殛雷掌的威力，他比任何人都清楚，这一掌，即便杀不了面前这头人猿，亦能将之重创！
就在许辰这般想着的时候，瞳孔微微一缩，只见得那头人猿竟然从仙路上缓缓站了起来，看起来竟然像是没事人一般。
“怎么会这样？”
许辰脸上迅速爬满了凝重之色。
人猿的肉身简直就是金刚不坏，硬吃殛雷掌一击，竟然依旧完好无损，这般强横的肉身，几乎无解！
content_en:
"Cang!"
The Zhuxian Sword struck the ape's palm fiercely, as if it struck a piece of immortal gold. The sound of gold and iron erupted, and a substantial violent force suddenly spread wildly. The Ancient Immortal Road, which was already on the verge of collapse, suddenly crumbled and the earthquake continued.
As the aftermath raged, Xu Chen flew backwards. His right hand, which was holding the Zhuxian Sword tightly, was slightly numb. Looking at the ape who only took one step back, his heart sank. Although the ape's strength was no longer at its peak, his strength was still terrifying, and his body was extremely hard...
"Roar~"
When Xu Chen flew upside down, the ape who stabilized his body did not give Xu Chen any time to breathe. It turned into an afterimage, waving its claws wildly, and black claw marks roared out, like an extremely sharp sword energy, tearing open the void and covering Xu Chen.
Facing such a ferocious attack by the ape, Xu Chen stepped down with his foot, forcibly stabilizing his body, and then waved the Immortal Killing Sword to resist the claw marks that were coming towards him.
“Ding ding ding ding!
! "
The sword light collided fiercely with the claw marks, and the sound of gold and iron resounded endlessly.
Xu Chen actually looked a little embarrassed for a moment, being steadily suppressed by the ape's offensive.
Although Xu Chen was at a disadvantage, his eyes were indeed extremely calm, and there was no panic in his offensive.
“Ding ding ding ding!
! "
The sound of gold and iron is endless.
Xu Chen was killed by the ape and kept retreating.
There was a clang.
Xu Chen's body shook and he flew out again.
However.
At the moment Xu Chen flew upside down.
A flash of fierceness flashed across his eyes
"Thunder Palm!"
The long-prepared attack was finally completed. He let out a low roar and slammed out a palm.
"Boom!
! "
Endless immortal power roared out, wrapped in the power of billions of thunders, turned into a big thunder hand, and fiercely killed Orang Utan Town.
Thunder Palm, a middle-grade immortal technique!
Xu Chen not only succeeded in practicing this immortal technique, but also practiced it to the peak level.
This palm was another one that Xu Chen had been preparing for a long time. It was far more powerful than imagined and could easily kill any master in the Earthly Immortal Realm instantly.
"Bang!"
This extremely cruel attack directly knocked the ape away fiercely, and hit the immortal road like a meteor.
"Hoo~"
Xu Chen slowly exhaled.
He knows the power of the Thunder Palm better than anyone else. Even if this palm cannot kill the ape in front of him, it can still seriously injure it!
Just when Xu Chen was thinking this, his pupils shrank slightly, and he saw the ape slowly stood up from the immortal road, looking like he was fine.
"How could this happen?"
Xu Chen's face quickly became filled with solemnity.
The human ape's physical body is simply indestructible. He could withstand a blow from the Thunder Palm and still remain intact. There is almost no solution to such a powerful physical body!
title_en: Chapter 3827 The Killing Ape Enters the Immortal Sect Chapter 3826 The Terrifying Creature on the Ancient Immortal Road
